questions.description: YAML file (relative to maya.yaml) with the evaluation questions; see $defs/questions_file

schema.description: Schema of the dataset and results tables (<catalog>.<schema> or a schema of the first catalog)

targets.description: What is evaluated: the served agents (G10), the Genie space (G5)

pass_threshold.description: Share of questions the agents must answer correctly

genie_pass_threshold.description: Share for the Genie space (default pass_threshold)

max_suggestions.description: More questions the eval_designer proposes (never scored); 0 skips it

judge_endpoint.description: Model Serving endpoint of the language model that judges answers

on_change.description: Rerun when a source table of the metric views changes

schedule.description: Quartz cron; replaces the trigger on change

notify.description: Emails notified when the evaluation fails

model.description: Model of the eval_designer agent (default: the harness model)

sql.description: SQL on the metric views giving the right answer (at most 50 rows)
